ranks: Commander Masters (CMM, 2023-08-04): the rest of the set (its top half was walked before)

blocked.name: For the Ancestors
blocked.why: "Choose a creature type" as the spell resolves, then a look at the top six for cards of that type — a spell has nowhere to keep the choice for the filter.

blocked.name: Jaya's Phoenix
blocked.why: "Copy the next loyalty ability you activate this turn when you activate it": a delayed copy of an activation.

blocked.name: Leori, Sparktouched Hunter
blocked.why: "Choose a planeswalker type. Until end of turn, whenever you activate an ability of a planeswalker of that type, copy that ability".

blocked.name: Omarthis, Ghostfire Initiate
blocked.why: "Manifest a number of cards equal to the number of counters on it": `manifest`'s count is a fixed number.

blocked.name: Rukarumel, Biologist
blocked.why: The chosen creature type added to Slivers and nontoken creatures — and to creature spells and cards you own outside the battlefield.

blocked.name: Sparkshaper Visionary
blocked.why: Any number of planeswalkers become 3/3 Bird creatures (no longer planeswalkers) with a granted "scry 1" combat-damage trigger until end of turn.
